# Reading fixtures

All document text, diagrams and example data are self-generated by `generate.mjs` and dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. They contain no user files.

Modern Word and slides are created with docx and PptxGenJS. Word contains native Office Math; slides contain speaker notes, tables and images. PDF and the image-only scan are generated with pdf-lib and a drawn PNG.

The legacy `reader.doc` and `reader.ppt` are actual OLE binary exports made by LibreOffice 26.2.6.3, using `doc:MS Word 97` and `ppt:MS PowerPoint 97`. They are not renamed OOXML files. `encrypted.pdf` is a genuine LibreOffice PDF encrypted with the public test password `fixture-secret`.

Regeneration: set `READER_LIBREOFFICE` to the converter executable, then run `node tests/fixtures/generate.mjs`. The manifest records source hashes and generator versions. Regeneration can change ZIP metadata and hashes.

Windows conversion verification used the official MSI (SHA-256 `f9877032fd908beb9c0ddf06df4af5c2e85f419c42e14876c4cce5aae5fb2660`) extracted into the ignored project runtime, without installing it system-wide. [Official download information](https://download.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/stable/26.2.6/win/x86_64/LibreOffice_26.2.6_Win_x86-64.msi.mirrorlist).

Rendered first pages of DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX were visually checked: the Chinese text, formula, table and diagram were present. PDF.js reported a TrueType hinting warning on converted Office text, without visible missing glyphs in these fixtures. Real documents can differ when fonts are missing; the app reports the conversion engine and that limitation.
